title: Convergence groups
description: Convergence groups on compact metric spaces, from the definition by sequences: every element is elliptic, parabolic or loxodromic, loxodromic elements have attracting and repelling fixed points and a compact fundamental domain, and the stabilizer of a loxodromic fixed point is virtually infinite cyclic; convergence actions and minimal actions pass to equivariant quotients, a convergence group on a continuum acts as a convergence group on its dendrite quotient, and the points of the completion of the cut points have supports in the continuum that control which of them a group element fixes.
